basic_details.short_information: Madhya Pradesh Bhoj Open University (MPBOU) has notified 1 vacancy for the post of Ombudsperson on a temporary, part-time basis for three years. Eligible candidates can apply offline by downloading the prescribed form and sending the completed application by post to the Registrar, Madhya Pradesh Bhoj Open University, Kolar Road, Bhopal, with the last date for submission being 3 November 2026. Applicants must be a domicile of the State of Madhya Pradesh and not related to the University. content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications in the prescribed form duly filled together with attested copies of certificates should be sent in an envelope superscripted “Application for the post of Ombudsperson” by post to the following address: Registrar, Madhya Pradesh Bhoj Open University, Kolar Road, Bhopal– 462016

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Educational Qualification: Retired Vice-Chancellor or retired Professor (who have worked as Dean/HOD) and has 10 years’ experience as a Professor at State/ Central Universities/ Institutions of National Importance/ Deemed to be Universities, or a former District Judge. Domicile Requirement: The post will be filled in by candidates domiciled in the State of Madhya Pradesh only. Age Limit: Appointed for a period of three years or until he/she attains the age of 70 years, whichever is earlier, from the date of assuming office. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Attested copies of degree or diploma certificates and statements of marks Certificates in support of educational qualifications and experience Matriculation or equivalent certificate in support of date of birth/age Caste Certificate and Caste validity certificate (if applicable) Physically handicapped certificate (if applicable) Last Pay Certificate Declaration that no case is pending or ongoing against the candidate in any court

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The appointment is made on a purely temporary basis as a part-time officer for a period of three years, governed by the UGC (Redressal of Grievances of Students) Regulations, 2023, based on application verification and fulfillment of eligibility criteria.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in MPBOU Ombudsperson Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for the post of Ombudsperson.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form is 3 November 2026 before 6:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible to apply for the MPBOU Ombudsperson post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be retired Vice-Chancellors, retired Professors with Dean/HOD experience and 10 years of experience as a Professor at State/Central Universities, Institutions of National Importance, or Deemed to be Universities, or former District Judges, and must be domiciled in Madhya Pradesh.

faq.question: Q4. What is the upper age limit for appointment?
faq.answer: The Ombudsperson shall be appointed for a period of three years or until he/she attains the age of 70 years, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q5. What is the remuneration offered for the Ombudsperson post?
faq.answer: The remuneration includes Rs. 3,000 sitting fees per day for hearing cases, along with Rs. 500 local conveyance.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline by post to the Registrar, Madhya Pradesh Bhoj Open University, Kolar Road, Bhopal– 462016.

faq.question: Q7. Can candidates from other states apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, the post will be filled by candidates domiciled in the State of Madhya Pradesh only, and candidates must not be related to the University.

faq.question: Q8. What documents must be enclosed with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must attach self-attested copies of degree/diploma certificates, marks sheets, age proof, experience certificates, last pay certificate, and a declaration that no court case is pending against them.
